definitions.gloss: drink diluted with hot water (esp. shochu)
definitions.explanation: An alcoholic drink, most often shochu, mixed with hot water; also the practice of diluting a drink this way. Popular in colder months.

examples.japanese: {焼酎|しょうちゅう}のお{湯|ゆ}{割|わ}りを{注文|ちゅうもん}した。
examples.english: I ordered shochu with hot water.

examples.japanese: {寒|さむ}い{夜|よる}はお{湯|ゆ}{割|わ}りが{体|からだ}を{温|あたた}める。
examples.english: On a cold night, a hot-water mix warms the body.

examples.japanese: この{焼酎|しょうちゅう}はお{湯|ゆ}{割|わ}りにすると{香|かお}りが{引|ひ}き{立|た}つ。
examples.english: This shochu's aroma comes out beautifully when mixed with hot water.

notes:
A drink — most often {焼酎|しょうちゅう} (shochu) — diluted with hot water, popular in colder months. Formed from お{湯|ゆ} (hot water) + {割|わ}り (dilution).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {焼酎|しょうちゅう}のお{湯|ゆ}{割|わ}り: shochu with hot water
- お{湯|ゆ}{割|わ}りにする: to mix with hot water

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {水割|みずわ}り: a drink diluted with cold water and ice
- ロック: on the rocks (over ice, undiluted)

cross_references.label: a drink diluted with cold water and ice
